summary: This Form 6-K reports a standard PDMR share acquisition under EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. The CEO purchased 6,825 ordinary shares at €14.67395 per share for a total of €100,149.71 in an open-market transaction on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity. This is a routine insider trading notification, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are present. The filing is a routine compliance disclosure, so it does not fit any special-situations category.
